name: TOB Communication Campaign Recipient
description: One row per (campaign, user) — the snapshotted recipient list a campaign actually sends to, with independent per-channel status. Deliberately its OWN top-level doctype rather than a Frappe child table, so the Flutter admin client can page through a large campaign's recipients directly via plain REST (contract SS1.6) rather than only ever seeing them nested inside the parent campaign document.

fields.label: User Name
fields.description: Denormalized full name at the time the campaign was created, so the recipient list never needs a per-row User join.

fields.label: Email Status
